blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday ordered the transfer of former Speaker Martin Romualdez to New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas. Associate Justice Karl Miranda issued the order after the testimony of Philippine General Hospital (PGH) Director Gerardo Legaspi, who told the court that Romualdez was medically stable and fit to […]...
